acceptanceCriteria.text: Mottainai consumes the proven shared TypeScript CI contract at an immutable `.github` commit.
Shared workflow checkout/setup/install executes against the correct repositories/revisions and uses no missing consumer-relative action path.
Every pre-migration Mottainai-specific required validation class remains present locally or is explicitly proven equivalent in the shared contract.
Current branch-protection/ruleset-required checks remain satisfied or an intentional check-name migration is coordinated without a gap.
Pull-request and current-main Actions evidence shows the reusable caller succeeds end to end.
A focused contract/static check prevents accidental mutable references or unsupported shared/local boundary drift where practical.
No unrelated product workflow is moved or refactored.

issue.title: ci: consume the organization TypeScript CI foundation without losing Mottainai-specific checks
